title: Fitz's Simple Job: Mackerel
description: *hic*... Listen, I'm lookin' for someone to do some work for me - this ole peg doesn't allow me to cast like I used to. Start simple - catch me 3 Mackerel and sell them at the fishmonger in town. Make sure you're using bait when fishing. Try digging in the dirt around the dock for worms.

objectives.description: Catch 3 Mackerel. Tip: Use bait! Try digging in the dirt around the dock for worms.
Sell 3 Mackerel at the Fishmonger in town.
